title: Under the Surface
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about water. In a creek the water pulls you to the left, in a deep pool it holds you up so you float, and in a tall pool it lifts you up and to the left to a ledge. Water is not a special thing: it is a block with a gravity setting, and the setting says which ways it pulls. Nothing here hurts. Signs explain each idea, and every level has a page on how it is made.

box.tagline: Which way does the water pull?
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has three pools to cross. A creek carries him to the left, a deep pool holds him up so he floats, and a tall one lifts him up and to the left to a ledge. Signs say what each level shows, and the manual says how each is made.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Water is only a block with a gravity setting: left, right, up or down
Made to be copied and taken apart
